title: 第9章 9 谎言
content_zh:
打了一辆出租，钟晓飞带着小薇直奔附近的一家豪华商场。跟在小薇的小屁股后面开始血拼，女人都是天生的购物狂，购物起来不要命，跟在小薇的后面，钟晓飞提着大包小包一路小跑的喘不过气来。

终于购物结束，代价是钟晓飞一个月的工资。

钟晓飞把小薇送上出租车，身心疲惫，声音很虚弱的说，“小薇，你先回家，姐夫还要去上班。”

“嗯，知道姐夫。你早点回家啊，我在家等你。”小薇嗲嗲的说。

钟晓飞心花怒放，刚才的疲惫一扫而光，回家两个字听得他全身的骨头都酥了，天啊！有这么一个漂亮性感的小姨子在家里等着，是多么幸福的一件事情啊，钟晓飞跟班再累，花再多的钱也愿意。

“姐夫再见。”小薇眨眨眼，坐车走了。

“再见。”钟晓飞精神抖擞的去上班，因为心情愉快，他脸带笑容，神采奕奕，走路带着风。

在公司的门口，他居然又遇见了女神吴怡洁！

情况和早上几乎完全一样，钟晓飞站在公司门口，吴怡洁从另一个方向走来，黑色的筒裙，白色的短袖衬衫，黑色的高跟鞋，标准的ol打扮，走路步伐轻盈，婀娜多姿，看的上班的男同事们眼都直了。

钟晓飞鼓起勇气迎了上去，因为他有一个很好的借口。虽然早上的事情很尴尬、很没有面子，但钟晓飞早就已经忘记了。

“吴秘书，谢谢你帮小薇找到了工作。”钟晓飞调息着呼吸，微笑着，让自己说话的语调尽量平稳。

吴怡洁站住了，冷漠的看着他，目光就像是在看着一个陌生人。又好像根本不知道钟晓飞在说什么？

钟晓飞的微笑尴尬，结结巴巴的又说，“……小薇的事，谢谢你啊……”在女神面前，他的心脏一直在剧烈的跳动，感觉有点喘不过气来。

“不用。”几秒钟后，吴怡洁冷冷的撂下两个字，走了。

钟晓飞站在原地，兴奋的脸色发红，因为女神终于同他说话了！虽然他还是没有机会解释”姐夫”的事情。

“晓飞，”钟晓飞进了办公室刚坐下，同事陈昊凑了过来，眨着眼睛神秘的笑，“加油啊，我看好你！”

“什么啊？”钟晓飞以为他说的是升职的事。

“还装？”陈昊翻了一下白眼，“我都看见你跟吴秘书说话了……”

吴怡洁是公司的第一美女，待字闺中，公司里面的每个男人都在关注她，没老婆的想娶她当老婆，有老婆的想拥她当小三。钟晓飞堵在公司门口跟吴怡洁说话，很多人都看见了，很快就成了公司里面议论的新闻。

大家都说钟晓飞是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉。

的确，从身份地位上讲，钟晓飞一点都配不上吴怡洁。

“别管别人怎么说，自己追求就对了，男人嘛，就得对自己狠一点，再说了，吴秘书能和你说话至少说明你有一点的希望。”陈昊鼓励钟晓飞。吴怡洁的冷艳是有名的，从来冷若冰霜，不但很少笑，而且不跟无关的人说话，公司里面的员工几百个，跟吴怡洁说过话的不超过两位数。今天钟晓飞能站在公司门口跟吴怡洁说话，已经算是一个不小的突破了。

“晓飞，向前冲，哥们永远支持你！”陈昊拍了一下钟晓飞的肩膀。

“谢了。”钟晓飞心里很温暖。不过想到“姐夫”的误会，他心里又有点黯然，所谓得到一件东西，同时也会失去一件东西，有了小薇，就要失去吴怡洁，鱼和熊掌果然不能兼得啊。

“对了，你小姨子怎么回事？中午在哪吃饭的？”陈昊又问。

“呀呵，你小子厉害了，老婆都没有哪来的小姨子？老实交代，她到底是谁？”陈昊很暧昧的问。

钟晓飞苦笑，“她真是我小姨子，只不过她姐姐最后并没有嫁给我……”

陈昊转眼珠子想了想，然后大笑，“我明白了，原来你小子想要双线发展啊，哈哈，她比吴秘书怎么样？是不是也胸大皮肤白……”

“别胡说。”钟晓飞举起右手，一本正经的说，“我对**发誓，我真是把她当小姨子的。”

“切，你拿**发誓就知道你的心不诚！再说了，一个小姨半个妻，和小姨子勾勾搭搭正合适。哈哈哈，啥时候介绍我认识一下，我好给你参谋参谋？”陈昊嬉皮笑脸的问。

“不用我介绍，明天你就能看见她。”

“她已经是ty公司的职员了，明天就会来上班。”

“你说啥？”陈昊惊讶的张大了嘴，合不拢的看着钟晓飞，ty公司对职员的要求非常的严格，每一个员工都是过五关斩六将才能挤进来，除非有特殊的关系，否则一般人是进不来的。

“你小子，行啊！”陈昊啧啧的称赞，他以为是钟晓飞把小姨子弄进公司的。

今天是星期一，股票和期货都不太稳定，钟晓飞观察了一会，没有敢出手。股市很快就收盘，接着，再浪费一点时间，开了一个小会，然后就下班。ty公司下午下班比较早，一般情况下，五点钟的时候公司就没人了。当然，像李三石那样玩道琼斯指数，或者是英国的纳斯达克，因为时差的原因，都是晚上加班的。

钟晓飞今天走的比较早，因为家里有一个小姨子在等着呢，小姨子第一天来，他很不放心。

出公司的时候，钟晓飞扭头看了一眼公司的四楼，吴怡洁的办公室就在公司大楼的四楼。这个时间吴怡洁应该还在办公室，想到她绝美的脸蛋，钟晓飞的心里麻酥酥的。什么时候吴怡洁能对自己嫣然一笑，那钟晓飞就心满意足了。

坐车回家，疾步上楼，开门进去的时候，忽然愣住了。

钟晓飞里外房间转了一圈，不见小薇，赶紧取出手机拨小薇的号码，拨号码的时候，他发现自己的手指有点抖，心也有点慌，就好像害怕小薇会忽然离开一样。

手机通了，那头传来了嗲嗲的声音。钟晓飞大声问：“小薇，你在哪里？”

钟晓飞松了一口气，接着质问，“不是不让你出去吗？你刚来，根本不认识路！”

小薇在笑，“姐夫你别着急啊？我不是一个人，我跟徐姐姐在一起。她带着我逛街的。”

“徐姐姐？哪个徐姐姐？”钟晓飞一时没有反应过来。

“还有哪个徐姐姐？当然是我了！”手机换成另外一个女人娇脆的声音。小薇在咯咯的娇笑。

钟晓飞也笑了，“疯婆子，你没上班？”

原来小薇在一起的是钟晓飞的红颜知己、女汉子徐佳佳。

“上午上了，下午请假，主要是听说你家里来了一个妹子，我特地跑过来参观一下。”

钟晓飞明白了，原本他应该想到的，昨天他跟徐佳佳打听小薇的名字，以徐佳佳好奇、急躁的性子，能忍一晚上已经是不错了，今天肯定会跑过来看。至于徐佳佳和小薇是怎么见面？怎么熟悉的？钟晓飞一点都不奇怪，因为两个美女都属于见面熟的类型。

不过很快的钟晓飞又紧张了起来，因为他担心徐佳佳会把事情的真相告诉李小薇！

钟晓飞和李小冉的事情，徐佳佳最清楚了，只要她跟小薇一说：你姐姐早就跟钟晓飞没有关系了，他不是你姐夫！

“疯婆子……你，你，没胡说什么吧？”钟晓飞结结巴巴问。。

“那就好，”钟晓飞讨好似的干笑，小声的嘱咐，“千万不要胡说，最好什么也不要说，嗯，回头请你去君悦！”

“少来！哼哼，你的鬼心思我还不知道？你不让我说，我偏要说！戳穿你的假面具，看你再装模作样的当姐夫！”徐佳佳“恶狠狠”的说。

钟晓飞一头的汗，“你要说就说吧，不过那样不好……”

“因为，因为……”钟晓飞绞尽脑汁的想找出理由，一时却想不出来。

“徐姐，你和姐夫说什么呢？这么亲热？”手机那头，小薇在咯咯的笑。

钟晓飞赶紧说，“疯婆子，电话里说不方便，回头我跟你解释。”

“哼，暂时相信你，你要是不给我一个合适的理由，我饶不了你！”

钟晓飞松了一口气，“好了疯婆子，告诉我，你们在哪？”

“不干啥，两个美女逛街，难道不需要一个挑夫吗？”

“挑夫不用，出纳倒是需要一个。记着把信用卡带上了。”

十分钟后，钟晓飞来到了海州最有名的sougo大型百货公司，在二楼电梯拐角处看见了小薇和徐佳佳，

两个美女正在内衣专柜前挑选内衣，亲昵的像是一对亲姐妹，

钟晓飞没有走过去，他是男人，到女人的内衣柜台前总是怪怪的，虽然他兜里藏着吴怡洁的蕾丝小内裤，不过这是他的秘密，可不能让别人知道。

闲的没事，脑子就开始胡思乱想，首先想到的就是徐佳佳会跟小薇说什么？如果小薇知道了实情又会怎么样？还会跟自己住在一起吗？唉，最坏的结果就是小薇离开自己搬到外面去处，虽然那并不是世界的末日，但钟晓飞肯定不愿意看到。到现在为止，钟晓飞对小薇并没有太多的非分之想，他只是觉得，这么可爱的小姨子，他一定要留在身边……

After taking a taxi, Zhong Xiaofei took Xiaowei straight to a nearby luxury shopping mall.Following Xiaowei's little butt, Zhong Xiaofei started shopping. Women are all born shopaholics, and shopping is life-threatening. Following Xiaowei, Zhong Xiaofei was out of breath as he trotted along carrying large and small bags.

The shopping was finally over, and the price was Zhong Xiaofei's one month's salary.

Zhong Xiaofei put Xiaowei into a taxi. He was exhausted physically and mentally, and said in a weak voice, "Xiaowei, you go home first, my brother-in-law has to go to work."

"Yeah, I know brother-in-law. You go home early, I'll wait for you at home." Xiaowei said coquettishly.

Zhong Xiaofei was so excited that all the fatigue just now was gone. Hearing the word "go home" made all the bones in his body go numb. Oh my God!What a blessing it is to have such a beautiful and sexy sister-in-law waiting at home. No matter how tired Zhong Xiaofei is, he is willing to spend more money.

"Goodbye, brother-in-law." Xiaowei winked and left in the car.

"Goodbye." Zhong Xiaofei went to work in high spirits. Because he was in a happy mood, he had a smile on his face, was in high spirits, and walked with wind.

At the door of the company, he unexpectedly met the goddess Wu Yijie again!

The situation was almost exactly the same as in the morning. Zhong Xiaofei was standing at the door of the company, and Wu Yijie came from the other direction. She was wearing a black tube skirt, a white short-sleeved shirt, black high-heeled shoes, and standard OL dress. She walked with a light and graceful pace, which made the male colleagues at work stare.

Zhong Xiaofei mustered up the courage to go forward because he had a good excuse.Although what happened in the morning was embarrassing and humiliating, Zhong Xiaofei had already forgotten it.

"Secretary Wu, thank you for helping Xiaowei find a job." Zhong Xiaofei adjusted his breathing, smiled, and kept his tone of voice as steady as possible.

Wu Yijie stopped and looked at him indifferently, as if looking at a stranger.And it seems like he has no idea what Zhong Xiaofei is talking about?

Zhong Xiaofei smiled awkwardly and stammered, "...about Xiaowei, thank you..." In front of the goddess, his heart was beating violently and he felt a little out of breath.

"No need." After a few seconds, Wu Yijie coldly put down the two words and left.

Zhong Xiaofei stood there, his face red with excitement, because the goddess finally spoke to him!Although he still didn't have a chance to explain about his "brother-in-law".

"Xiaofei," Zhong Xiaofei entered the office and just sat down. His colleague Chen Hao came over, blinking and smiling mysteriously, "Come on, I'm optimistic about you!"

"What?" Zhong Xiaofei thought he was talking about promotion.

"Still pretending?" Chen Hao rolled his eyes, "I even saw you talking to Secretary Wu..."

Wu Yijie is the most beautiful woman in the company. She is a married woman. Every man in the company is paying attention to her. Those who don't have a wife want to marry her as their wife, and those who have a wife want to make her their mistress.Zhong Xiaofei blocked the door of the company and talked to Wu Yijie. Many people saw it, and it soon became the news discussed in the company.

Everyone said that Zhong Xiaofei was a toad who wanted to eat swan meat.

Indeed, in terms of status and status, Zhong Xiaofei is not worthy of Wu Yijie at all.

"Don't care what others say, just pursue it yourself. As a man, you have to be tough on yourself. Besides, Secretary Wu's ability to talk to you at least shows that you have some hope." Chen Hao encouraged Zhong Xiaofei.Wu Yijie is famous for her aloofness. She has always been as cold as ice. Not only does she seldom smile, but she also doesn't talk to irrelevant people. There are hundreds of employees in the company, and only two digits of people have spoken to Wu Yijie.Today Zhong Xiaofei was able to stand in front of the company and talk to Wu Yijie, which was already a big breakthrough.

"Xiaofei, move forward, my brother will always support you!" Chen Hao patted Zhong Xiaofei on the shoulder.

"Thank you." Zhong Xiaofei felt warm in his heart.However, thinking about the misunderstanding of his "brother-in-law", he felt a little sad. As the saying goes, gaining something means losing something at the same time. If you have Xiaowei, you will lose Wu Yijie. You really can't have your cake and eat it too.

"By the way, what happened to your sister-in-law? Where did you eat at noon?" Chen Hao asked again.

"Oh, you are so awesome, but your wife doesn't have a sister-in-law? Tell me honestly, who is she?" Chen Hao asked ambiguously.

Zhong Xiaofei smiled bitterly, "She is really my sister-in-law, but her sister did not marry me in the end..."

Chen Hao rolled his eyes and thought for a moment, then laughed, "I understand, it turns out that you want to develop in both directions, haha, how is she compared to Secretary Wu? Does she also have big breasts and fair skin..."

"Don't talk nonsense." Zhong Xiaofei raised his right hand and said seriously, "I swear to **, I really treat her as my sister-in-law."

"Tch, you swear on your motherfucker that you know your heart is dishonest! Besides, it's just right for an aunt and a half-wife to hook up with my sister-in-law. Hahaha, when are you going to introduce me to me so that I can give you some advice?" Chen Hao asked with a playful smile.

"You can see her tomorrow without my introduction."

"She is already an employee of Ty Company and will come to work tomorrow."

"What did you say?" Chen Hao opened his mouth in surprise and looked at Zhong Xiaofei. TY Company had very strict requirements for employees. Every employee had to pass five levels to get in. Unless there was a special relationship, ordinary people could not get in.

"You're good, kid!" Chen Hao praised, thinking that it was Zhong Xiaofei who got his sister-in-law into the company.

Today is Monday, and stocks and futures are not stable. Zhong Xiaofei observed for a while and did not dare to take action.The stock market closed soon, and then, I wasted a little more time, had a small meeting, and then got off work.Ty company gets off work relatively early in the afternoon. Under normal circumstances, the company will be empty by five o'clock.Of course, people like Li Sanshi who play the Dow Jones Index or the British Nasdaq work overtime at night because of the time difference.

Zhong Xiaofei left early today because there was a sister-in-law waiting at home. On the first day of his sister-in-law's arrival, he was very worried.

When leaving the company, Zhong Xiaofei turned around and glanced at the fourth floor of the company. Wu Yijie's office was on the fourth floor of the company building.Wu Yijie should still be in the office at this time. Thinking of her beautiful face, Zhong Xiaofei felt numb in his heart.When Wu Yijie can smile at herself, Zhong Xiaofei will be satisfied.

I took the car home and hurried upstairs. When I opened the door and went in, I was suddenly stunned.

Zhong Xiaofei walked around the room, but Xiaowei was nowhere to be seen. He quickly took out his mobile phone and dialed Xiaowei's number. When dialing the number, he found that his fingers were shaking a little and his heart was a little panicked, as if he was afraid that Xiaowei would suddenly leave.

The phone went through, and there was a buzzing voice on the other end.Zhong Xiaofei asked loudly: "Xiaowei, where are you?"

Zhong Xiaofei breathed a sigh of relief and then asked, "Aren't you not allowed to go out? You just came here and you don't know the way at all!"

Xiaowei was smiling, "Brother-in-law, don't worry? I'm not alone. I'm with Sister Xu. She took me shopping."

"Sister Xu? Which sister Xu?" Zhong Xiaofei didn't react for a moment.

"Who else is Sister Xu? Of course it's me!" The phone was replaced by another woman's crisp voice.Xiaowei was giggling.

Zhong Xiaofei also smiled, "Crazy woman, you didn't go to work?"

It turns out that Xiaowei is with Zhong Xiaofei's confidante and tomboy Xu Jiajia.

"I went to school in the morning and asked for leave in the afternoon. The main reason is that I heard that a girl came to your house. I came here specially to visit."

Zhong Xiaofei understood. He should have thought that yesterday he asked Xu Jiajia about Xiaowei's name. With Xu Jiajia's curious and impatient temper, it was good to be able to endure it for one night. She would definitely come over to see it today.As for how Xu Jiajia and Xiao Wei met?How are you familiar?Zhong Xiaofei is not surprised at all, because the two beauties are familiar to each other.

But soon Zhong Xiaofei became nervous again because he was worried that Xu Jiajia would tell Li Xiaowei the truth!

Xu Jiajia knows best about Zhong Xiaofei and Li Xiaoran. As soon as she tells Xiaowei: Your sister has nothing to do with Zhong Xiaofei, he is not your brother-in-law!

"Crazy woman...you, you, aren't talking nonsense, are you?" Zhong Xiaofei asked stammering..

"That's good," Zhong Xiaofei smiled dryly and asked in a low voice, "Don't talk nonsense. It's best not to say anything. Well, I'll invite you to Grand Hyatt later!"

"Come on! Humph, I don't know what you are thinking? You won't let me tell you, so I have to tell you! Let me expose your mask and see if you pretend to be a brother-in-law again!" Xu Jiajia said "viciously".

Zhong Xiaofei was sweating, "If you want to say it, just say it, but that's not good..."

"Because, because..." Zhong Xiaofei racked his brains to find a reason, but couldn't think of it for the moment.

"Sister Xu, what are you talking about with your brother-in-law? Are you so affectionate?" On the other end of the phone, Xiaowei was giggling.

Zhong Xiaofei quickly said, "Crazy woman, it's inconvenient to say it on the phone. I'll explain it to you later."

"Humph, I believe you for now. If you don't give me a suitable reason, I won't be able to spare you!"

Zhong Xiaofei breathed a sigh of relief, "Okay, crazy woman, tell me, where are you?"

"Nothing, just two beauties going shopping, don't they need a porter?"

"You don't need a porter, but you need a cashier. Remember to bring your credit card."

Ten minutes later, Zhong Xiaofei arrived at Sougo, the most famous large department store in Haizhou, and saw Xiaowei and Xu Jiajia at the corner of the elevator on the second floor.

Two beauties were choosing underwear in front of the underwear counter, as close as a pair of sisters.

Zhong Xiaofei didn't walk over. He was a man and it was always strange to go to a women's underwear counter. Although he had Wu Yijie's lace panties hidden in his pocket, this was his secret and he couldn't let others know.

I had nothing to do, so my mind started to think wildly. The first thing that came to my mind was what would Xu Jiajia say to Xiaowei?What would happen if Xiaowei knew the truth?Will you still live with yourself?Alas, the worst result is that Xiaowei leaves her and moves outside. Although that is not the end of the world, Zhong Xiaofei definitely doesn't want to see it.Until now, Zhong Xiaofei didn't think too much about Xiaowei. He just felt that he must stay with such a lovely sister-in-law...
